'''Badna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war he lived on the capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the Republic, [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where he worked in the Equipment Requisitions area of the [[Senate Commercial District]] as a vendor of [[Armor/Legends|light armor]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Badna appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Light Armor Vendor for Republic players on Coruscant.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> he was removed from the game along with the rest of the Light Armor Vendors.<ref name="TOR" />
